exposure: Women with pre-eclampsia vs. women without pre-eclampsia
Preterm premature rupture of fetal membranes (PPROM)
Women with PPROM vs. women without PPROM
cohort: 128 women from an original cohort of 801 healthy Danish women with a singleton pregnancy
finding: Fibulin-1 levels increase significantly throughout pregnancy and are associated with PPROM but not late pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: The decrease in fibulin-1 levels at delivery was more pronounced after cesarean section than after vaginal delivery.
